text: Because the FLRW universe is homogeneous, no comoving observer occupies a special central point of the expansion — every comoving observer sees distant galaxies receding according to Hubble's law v = H₀d.
explanation: True. Homogeneity means there is no special location, so no galaxy is the center of the expansion; the recession is the uniform stretching of the comoving coordinate grid, seen identically by every comoving observer. Hubble's law v = H₀d follows from the proper distance d = a·χ giving v = ȧ·χ = (ȧ/a)d. The apparent recession of all galaxies from us does not make us central.
